rows.text: • Full-year 2026 Adjusted Diluted EPS 4 is expected to be in the range of $5.72 to $5.79, growth of 8% to 10%.
Our guidance anticipates pre-tax charges of approximately $0.30 to $0.35 per diluted share for the full year 2026.
The tax benefit of these charges is expected to be approximately ($0.08) to ($0.09) per diluted share for the full year 2026.
Our guidance anticipates a pre-tax benefit of approximately ($0.18) per diluted share with a corresponding tax expense of approximately $0.05 per diluted share for the full year 2026.
• Full-year 2026 Adjusted Diluted EPS 3 is expected to be in the range of $5.70 to $5.82, growth of 8% to 10%.
Our guidance anticipates pre-tax charges of approximately $0.50 to $0.70 per diluted share for the full year 2026.
The tax benefit of these charges is expected to be approximately ($0.13) to ($0.18) per diluted share for the full year 2026.
Our guidance anticipates a pre-tax benefit of approximately ($0.18) per diluted share with a corresponding tax expense of approximately $0.05 per diluted share for the full year 2026.
